text: User: join the tenex-edge wallet-work channel and review/advice/re-orient/help in case you see anything going wrong or missing something -- check on it every like 30 minutes or so [...] User: Recurring wallet-work watch (every ~30 min): read the tenex-edge #wallet-work channel for new messages since my last check (chat 801aaa02), check open wallet/nip60 PRs and their CI status, and check origin/master health. Review for anything going wrong, missing, or off-plan vs epic #2864. Post a short correction/advice to #wallet-work only if there's something worth flagging (don't narrate routine progress). Then reschedule the next ~30 min check.
